claim: The sample demo never reads or changes the user's real library state.
sandbox: fresh browser context with a sentinel real-library key; use search and reset; assert only demo:rsl:library-state:v1 changes

claim: Exports imported highlights as plain Markdown.
sandbox: open /demo/ from clean storage; export bundled highlights; inspect the downloaded Markdown contents

claim: The website and sample demo make no analytics or advertising requests.
sandbox: record every request across landing, search, and sample collection; allow only same-origin and the documented GitHub release API

claim: Catalogue, collection, USB, and Markdown tools do not require a purchase.
sandbox: fresh demo context without a license; assert core task controls are enabled and no checkout link is present

claim: Catalogue, collection, and Markdown tools reopen offline after the first demo visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context; load /demo/ online under its service worker; set context offline; reload and assert sample catalogue state

claim: Scanning book metadata does not rewrite the source file.
where: desktop empty state, privacy page, README
sandbox: temporary source PDF; record bytes, scan it through the native inspection path, and assert exact bytes remain

claim: PDF titles and authors stored as UTF-16 or PDFDocEncoding are decoded without replacement characters.
sandbox: temporary directory containing a generated PDF with Unicode title and author; scan the file and assert exact decoded values

claim: USB sync preserves source bytes, verifies copied bytes, and skips an unchanged repeat copy.
sandbox: temporary source and device directories; copy twice; compare source and destination bytes and inspect the device manifest
